data.content_ref: inline:When the standard grounded operator is not confluent under an enrichment, do not compute a least fixed point; instead order all grounded extensions by a polynomial-time computable lexicographic priority on committed roots and select the first. This strengthens the semantics by making choices explicit while preserving determinism and validity of committed roots. Criticizable because it abandons skeptical agreement and reintroduces a choice principle, so reinstatement is no longer derived but selected, and polynomial cost only holds if the number of extensions is polynomially bounded.
